thread:
Maria: Quick heads up — candidate for Senior Infra is scheduled 10:00a PT tomorrow. Jordan mentioned they're OOO for a block of the morning. Can folks cover if needed?
Maria: Also: we need a debrief scribe, confirm rubric weights (take-home vs onsite system design), and note candidate requested live captions / transcript.
Liam: I can cover the 10a slot if Jordan can't. I can also scribe — happy to take notes and paste the debrief afterwards. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Thanks Liam — yep I'm out 9:30–11:00 for an appointment. Appreciate the cover. Quick rubric Q: are we still on 1–5 scoring and using weights? I thought this role had been adjusted recently.
Sarah: For infra we've leaned a bit heavier on collaboration/context for this hire. Previous suggestion was 35/35/30 but hiring manager might want take-home heavier.
Maria: Aisha (hiring mgr) asked me to propose 45/35/20 (take-home/system-design/collab). I'll confirm with her and update.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: recording & transcript policy — get explicit consent from the candidate before starting. Use the consent template: `/msg candidate "We'd like to record a short clip and provide live captions. Do you consent?"`
Liam: Re: take-home — do we allow a small follow-up patch submission? Candidate sent a minor bugfix after the deadline once before.
Jordan: We only allow resubmits if the take-home instructions explicitly permit it. Otherwise score based on the submitted artifact and focus on follow-up questions in the interview.
Sarah: Vote: I'm +1 for 45/35/20 if hiring manager confirms. Also happy to be backup interviewer if needed.
Maria: OK — plan: Liam = scribe, Sarah = backup interviewer, Jordan = original interviewer (if able), Maria will confirm weights with Aisha and post final rubric by 5:00pm PT today.
Liam: Sweet — I'll prepare the debrief template and paste it after the loop. Can someone drop the final weight numbers here once confirmed?
Maria: Will do. Also, action item: whoever greets the candidate, please confirm they still want captions + consent to recording (copy the PeopleOpsBot text).
Sarah: Got it. I'll handle the candidate greeting if Jordan is OOO.
Maria: Thank you all :pray:
